# Rule

* [Identifier rules (sign-up and login)](identifier-rules.md) - An identifier is trimmed to 3 to 254 characters; one containing "@" must be an ASCII email address, and any other must be a username of letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; uniqueness ignores letter case.
* [List filter, search and paging semantics](list-search-and-paging.md) - The to-do list filters on done status, matches a literal lower-cased substring of title or description, orders newest first with a total order, pages 20 at a time, and clamps a page past the last to the last valid page.
* [Password rules](password-rules.md) - A password is 8 to 128 code points, is not trimmed or normalised, and is stored only as an Argon2id hash of the whole password.
* [Return-to after login and not-found routing](return-to-and-not-found.md) - After login the user goes only to the app's own to-do routes named in returnTo, otherwise to /todos, and an undefined address shows the not-found page only to a signed-in user.
* [Session lifetime](session-lifetime.md) - A session lasts 8 hours from login, is never extended by activity, ends with no warning, and an expired session is refused and its row deleted.
* [To-do field rules](todo-field-rules.md) - A to-do title is 1 to 200 characters after trimming, a description is at most 2000 characters, the due date is a required strict YYYY-MM-DD date, and priority is LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH with MEDIUM as the create default.
* [Whitespace trimming](whitespace-trimming.md) - Leading and trailing whitespace is removed using the 25 Unicode White_Space code points, identically in the API and the SPA, and zero-width characters are kept.
